posts.copy:
Morning routines don't have to be complicated. After 90 days of doing just 3 simple things every morning, here's what changed for me 👇

What's your go-to morning habit? Drop it below — I'm genuinely curious what works for you.
posts.visualDescription: No visual needed for text-only post. If boosted, use a warm-toned lifestyle photo of someone journaling at a sunlit desk.
posts.engagementHook: What's your go-to morning habit? Drop it below — I'm genuinely curious what works for you.

posts.copy:
Mental Health Awareness Month reminder: the smallest changes often make the biggest difference.

For me, it was tracking my mood patterns instead of just 'feeling bad' generally. Once I could SEE the patterns, I could actually do something about them.
posts.visualDescription: Infographic showing a simple mood tracking chart over 30 days. Clean design with brand colors (sage green, warm beige). Chart shows upward trend line. Bottom text: 'Small changes. Big impact.' Include WellnessApp subtle logo in corner.
posts.engagementHook: What small change has made the biggest difference for your mental health? I'd love to hear your experience.

frames.visualDescription: Bold white text on brand sage green background, casual handwritten font style
Poll sticker on a warm-toned background with emoji accents

frames.content: My top 3: Journal, Walk, Water before coffee
frames.visualDescription: Numbered list on calming gradient background (cream to sage green)

variations.altCopy:
I stopped overcomplicating my morning routine and tried something embarrassingly simple instead.

3 things. Every day. No exceptions.

Journal for 5 min. Walk for 10 min. Water before coffee.

90 days later: better sleep, less anxiety, and I actually look forward to mornings.

What's your 'embarrassingly simple' routine?
variations.altVisual: Overhead flat-lay photo of a journal, water glass, and sneakers on a wooden surface. Warm morning light. Minimal, clean aesthetic.
variations.rationale: Tests a self-deprecating hook ('embarrassingly simple') and adds a visual element. The vulnerability angle tends to drive more comments on Facebook.

metadata.boostRecommendations: Boost fb-post-002 (Mental Health infographic) after 24h of organic performance. Budget: $25/day for 3 days. Target: Interest in wellness + mental health, ages 25-45.
metadata.crossPostStrategy: Post to Page first. After 2-4 hours, share to Groups with a modified intro: 'Saw this on my Page and thought this community would relate — [topic]. What are your thoughts?' Stagger Group posts by 24 hours.
